title: Template:Cite/doc
content: ;Description :This template is used to mark text as needing sourcing. ;Syntax :Place {{t|cite}} after unsourced and/or questionable text so that its implication is self explanatory as to what is lacking citation. If necessary, use the article's talk page to discuss further details. [[Category:General wiki templates|{{PAGENAME}}]][[Category:Template documentation|{{PAGENAME}}]]
